profit_quality.assessment: 2024 reported net profit is not a clean operating-cash denominator. Profit before tax was RMB -4.201m, net profit turned positive mainly because prior-year PRC CIT over-provision of RMB8.847m was reversed. The operating segments earned RMB4.306m excluding government subsidies, while 2024 operating cash flow of RMB33.471m relied materially on a RMB61.113m increase in trade and other payables. Main denominator therefore uses RMB4.306m pre-haircut and a 0.30 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Remove bank deposit interest from sustainable operating profit because detachable deposits would not remain with the purchased operating business.
Do not treat the RMB8.847m tax over-provision reversal as sustainable profit.
Treat the RMB21.822m FX loss and RMB1.084m derivative loss as volatility evidence rather than normal operating earnings.
Capex proxy is RMB10.495m purchase of PPE plus RMB0.649m deposit paid for PPE acquisitions.
Working-capital evidence is weak: inventories increased RMB7.712m, trade and other receivables increased RMB37.294m, and trade and other payables increased RMB61.113m.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB33.471m in 2024 and RMB24.409m in 2023, but 2024 operating cash before working-capital movements was RMB12.393m and depended on supplier/payable financing.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Three-year net profit median is negative; current-year net profit is supported by tax reversal and deposit interest; receivables and inventories consume cash while payables release cash. Use 0.30 rather than null because the core segment was marginally profitable and operating cash flow has been positive for two disclosed years.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported operating cash flow positive, but not cleanly distributable because working-capital movement and payables are material.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No split between maintenance and growth capex; use reported PPE cash purchase plus PPE acquisition deposit as conservative capex proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital included increases in inventory and receivables, offset by a large increase in payables; cash conversion is not stable enough for a high factor.
